slate.footer: Window: games starting 6:00pm CT or later. Wallet money counts only from wallets with positive ROI in this sport and market (all-time and last 30 days). Cold money not counted includes Packers @ Rams Over $48.5K (NFL totals -44.8% ROI), Rams -2.5 $8.0K and $8.6K on Rams ML. 20 more Pinnacle Strong stable sides missed the 5-play cap; none has a counted second source, so start time and listing order broke the tie. They include Under 43.5 Packers @ Rams, Over 234 Nets @ Bucks and Under 6.5 Canucks @ Red Wings. St. Thomas ML and Omaha ML also show Vegas Whale Respect 100, which cards do not count. Wallet-row prices are first seen (Timberwolves ML is +113 at Pinnacle now; Pinnacle has a Lean, not Strong, on the Thunder). Kings @ Warriors: $3.7K of counted wallet money is on the Over, against the Under play. Vegas counts Vegas Backed and Pressure Move. Tier rules are fixed. Star is a rule-based screen, not a prediction.
